nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what happened to the mug requested to be moved, and where is it relative to the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Assess the requested mug using visual correspondence between source and edited images without assuming unprovided attributes. Complete only when evidence supports that the source mug was relocated and is now to the right of the headphones; a newly appearing mug to the right alone does not establish relocation if the source mug remains or a duplicate/residual is evident. Partial when the source mug shows movement toward the right but has not reached the right of the headphones, or when relocation is evident but the requested final relation is not achieved. Absent when there is no progress toward moving the mug right. Unknown when the mug's correspondence or movement cannot be established from the images. Do not infer progress from unrelated edits.
nodes.binding: the mug requested to be moved; the headphones

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
